author: IBM Technology
description:
Learn more about Cyber Resilience here → https://ibm.biz/~VtUoOk5oA

Ransomware rarely starts with a ransom note. Jeff Crume explains how storage systems detect ransomware early using entropy analysis, machine learning, monitoring, and cyber-resilient design. Learn how organizations can identify attacks faster and reduce data loss before ransomware spreads.

00:00 - Understanding Modern Ransomware Threats
00:22 - Why Ransomware Is a Data Problem
01:13 - Essential First Steps: Patching, Training, and Endpoint Protection
01:55 - How Ransomware Spreads Across Systems
02:26 - Why Storage Is Your Earliest Line of Defense
02:30 - The Four Rs of Reliable Backups
04:14 - Detecting Ransomware Before the Pop Up Appears
04:55 - Using Entropy, Compression, and Dedup Signals for Early Detection
07:01 - Spotting Mass Overwrites, Renames, and Partial Encryption
08:31 - Responding Fast: Isolation, Lockdown, and Recovery Points
09:11 - Integrating Storage with SIEM and SOAR for Coordinated Defense

title: Ransomware Detection: Why Storage Finds the Attack First
